correctness.rationale: Taking phase differences of the original three unit-coupled equations yields xdot=cos y−cos(x+y)=H_y and ydot=cos(x+y)−cos x=−H_x. The exact factorization H=4sin(x/2)sin(y/2)sin((x+y)/2) gives opposite sign triangles and exactly three torus circles through synchrony at level0. The Hessian of log H is negative definite inside each triangle, so all positive and negative regular energy levels are single simple ovals about ±2pi/3; the three zero-level arcs are homoclinic to the degenerate origin. At the positive center det Hess H=9/4, hence linearized frequency3/2 and small-orbit period4pi/3; reflection yields the negative case. Three corners and bounded off-corner travel give the displayed full period constant. Fresh exact symbolic factorization, Hessian determinant and high-precision identity 2^(2/3)B(1/3,1/3)=2B(1/3,1/2)=8.4130926319527255 independently agree with the source and with the *earlier* published period formula.
